args: case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) GALTAROOT="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Galta";; Linux) GALTAROOT="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/galta";; *) printf "Galta local MCP is not supported on this platform.\n" >&2; exit 1;; esac; if [ -x "$GALTAROOT/current/Resources/galta-mcp" ]; then exec "$GALTAROOT/current/Resources/galta-mcp"; fi; if [ -x "$GALTAROOT/bin/galta-mcp" ]; then exec "$GALTAROOT/bin/galta-mcp"; fi; printf "Open the Galta Mac app and connect your browser before using this plugin.\n" >&2; exit 1
